description: This file defines the PrivateTempStore class in Drupal, which manages temporary, non-cache data storage for individual users, including methods for storing, retrieving, deleting data, and managing locks.

classes.name: PrivateTempStore
classes.description: A class for managing temporary, user-specific data storage with locking and expiration features in Drupal.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the PrivateTempStore with storage, lock backend, user, request stack, and expiration time.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves data associated with a key if owned by the current user.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Stores data for a key, creating a lock during the process, and associates it with the current user or session.

methods.name: getMetadata
methods.description: Returns metadata (owner and last updated time) for a key.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes data for a key if owned by the current user, releasing the lock.

methods.name: createKey
methods.description: Creates a unique key by prefixing with owner identifier.

methods.name: getOwner
methods.description: Determines the owner based on user ID or session ID.
